contract: Two-player semantic effects: checkmate > check > capture, for visuals and audio. Ordinary movement audio is independent. Highest-priority effect is selected before visibility preferences. Three Kingdoms keeps simultaneous localized visuals, with one highest-priority semantic audio cue.
findings: Live RoundController.onBoardMove and pluginMove announced provisional capture before the authoritative apiMove supplied check/mate. This is shared by Standard Xiangqi, Jieqi, Mini Xiangqi and Manchu, including premoves and alternative input. Both native GameController and LiveBoardSession had the same split announcement.
The shared board previously selected visual priority after filtering by enabled effects, allowing lower effects to substitute for disabled higher effects.
Deduplication operated on individual effect names, allowing a later partial acknowledgment to announce a lower-priority effect. Backward navigation did not always reset an existing move identity.

audit.surface: Live two-player games, local bots, plugins, premoves
audit.result: Explicit optimistic phase preserves responsive motion and the ordinary move cue; authoritative confirmation supplies the single semantic effect. Server move events already carry capture, check, termination and status together; no backend computation or protocol changes.

audit.surface: Analysis, studies, puzzle transitions, manuals and instructional boards
audit.result: Complete rules/transition facts feed the shared board; canonical priority now applies centrally.

audit.surface: Live spectators, TV, replay and embeds
audit.result: Complete incoming/replayed facts use the same gate. Backward traversal has only movement audio; jumps/corrections are silent. Duplicate confirmations cannot replay or downgrade effects.

Retained same-river capture/check pairs, distinct rivers, elimination and victory territory overlays. Audio still chooses one primary semantic effect. Optimistic transitions cannot fabricate victory indicators.
One canonical priority selector. Mate retains its existing spoken/stylized audio components, with no capture/check audio layered on top. Sound and reduced-motion preferences preserved.
